neighbours.label: the encouragement formulas 'keep up the good work', 'keep it up' and 'way to go' in comments
fire: Thanks for the lovely article, keep up the good work!
Your garden looks amazing this year. Keep it up!
You finished the marathon in record time. Way to go, Sam!
Love reading your recipes. Keep up the great work.
Such a helpful tutorial, please keep up the awesome posts.
Congrats on the new job, way to go!
Great progress on the house, keep up the hard work, guys.
Your daughter must be proud of you. Keep it up, mate!
quiet: Thanks for the lovely article, I shared it with my sister.
Your garden looks amazing this year. What fertilizer do you use?
You finished the marathon in record time. How did you train?
Love reading your recipes. The soup was a hit with my kids.
Such a helpful tutorial, it fixed my problem in minutes.
Congrats on the new job, when do you start?
I can't keep up with the news these days, there's so much.
Your daughter must be proud of you. She told me about the trip.
